description: Browser-based real-time multiplayer social game for Kerala.
name: kerala-battle

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@kerala-battle/shared && npm run build --workspace=@kerala-battle/web && npm run build --workspace=@kerala-battle/server
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@kerala-battle/shared && concurrently -n web,server -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=@kerala-battle/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@kerala-battle/server"
